en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a small northern town in winter, showing snow-covered ground and a partially frozen river or lake in the foreground. On the left stands a prominent church with a tall clock tower and spire. Low wooden and masonry buildings line the water on the right. The caption in Swedish at the top left reads "Parti från Arjepluog," indicating a scenic view from the town.
